DERIVATIVES

Services / Sales & Trading / Derivatives
Derivatives

– Options
– Futures
– Swaps
– Structured Products

Arqaam provides Derivatives services including structuring, pricing and trading a wide variety of equity options, futures and swaps on local and internationally traded securities, which are either Over – the – Counter (OTC) or exchange traded.
